segments.say: Almost every quant fund forces its portfolio to be industry-neutral. One of the world's largest asset managers even told regulators why: sector bets don't add value.
captions: Almost every quant fund forces its portfolio to be industry-neutral.
One of the world's largest asset managers even told regulators why:
sector bets don't add value.

segments.say: But claims like that are almost never tested in the open. The data is expensive, and most backtests quietly leak the future.
captions: But claims like that are almost never tested in the open.
The data is expensive, and most backtests quietly leak the future.

segments.say: So we rebuilt the model from free public filings. Two point seven million facts, each used only after it became public, with the test period locked in code before we looked.
captions: So we rebuilt the model from free public filings.
2.7 million facts, each used only after it became public,
with the test period locked in code before we looked.

segments.say: And you can explore all of it. Switch the universe, the peer definition, or the time period, and every statistic is recomputed live.

segments.say: In the locked test, industry bets earned a Sharpe ratio of zero point six eight. The claim survives, but only narrowly.
captions: In the locked test, industry bets earned a Sharpe ratio of 0.68.

segments.say: Then the twist. The market-neutral book wasn't neutral. Its real market beta was zero point one five. Hedge it out, and the Sharpe falls to zero point four six.
captions: Then the twist.

Its real market beta was 0.15.
Hedge it out, and the Sharpe falls to 0.46.
